text:
alex: Heads up — several customers hit quota rejections during short bursts when tool-calls + retries happen. Error shows tokens exceeded even though nominal usage should fit burst window. Anyone seen this pattern?

maria: yep, saw a slack thread yesterday. I think it's related to how we do reservation vs final billing. :thinking_face:

ben: can you paste the logs/example trace?

alex: paste: ```INFO request=abc123 org=org-77 phase=reserve tokens=120 status=reserved
INFO request=abc123 phase=toolcall tool_id=tc-9 prompt_tokens=90 streamed=1
INFO request=abc123 phase=completion completion_tokens=140 billed_total=230
WARN request=abc123 retry=1 reserve_attempt tokens=120 reserve_status=failed reason=quota_exceeded
```

maria: that looks like we reserved 120 at start, then after completion we call reserve again (or increment) for the completion tokens without deduping the request_id. retry tries to reserve again and trips the burst.

sam: so two problems: (1) we sometimes do an extra reserve after the stream completes; (2) retries repeat the reservation call without idempotency. Together they push instantaneous accounting over the burst window.

ben: do we know where the second reserve is triggered? is it in the high-level completion handler or in the toolcall adapter?

oscar: quick glance — adapter flow: reserve(onReceive) -> stream toolcall -> onComplete calculate final tokens -> reserve(final_delta). If a retry occurs at the streaming layer we re-run reserve(onReceive) and then reserve(final_delta) again. No global dedupe.

maria: proposal: change reserve API semantics to be delta-based with an optional request_id for idempotency. Pattern: initial reserve with estimate, later call adjust_reservation with request_id and delta (can be negative). Quota service treats request_id as TTL-key and ignores duplicate adjusts.

oscar: example API snippet: ```POST /v1/quota/reserve {
  "org_id": "org-77",
  "api_key": "ak-xxxx",
  "request_id": "abc123",
  "tokens_delta": 120,
  "reason": "initial_estimate"
}
POST /v1/quota/adjust {
  "request_id": "abc123",
  "tokens_delta": 110,
  "reason": "final_billing"
}```

ben: that looks sane. Also add sliding-window burst check against "effective outstanding reserved" not summed raw calls. Right now we sum both pending and final which double counts concurrent attempts.

alex: console UX: customers are confused because the per-key dashboard shows spikes during these incidents. Could we surface 'pending reservations' vs 'committed billed' and a note when adjustments are in flight?

maria: yes — plan: quota-service will expose pending_reservations metric per key + org. Console will show a tiny badge on the quota chart. I'll own the service change + metric.

ops-bot: ticket created: QSRV-1023 "Quota double-counting on toolcall retries" assigned to maria

maria: I'll open a PR to add request_id TTL dedupe + delta adjust endpoint. Will also add a short integration test that simulates retry loop + completion path. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sam: can we run a reconciliation for the last 24h to correct any double-billed tokens before we push the fix? Might be noisy but customers will appreciate it.

maria: yes — I'll add a one-off reconcile job after the canary. It will backfill only orgs with >0.1% token delta anomalies. Estimated affected tokens ~0.2% of last 24h.

alex: deploy plan? want canary before full rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued for cluster "quota-canary" at 04:00 UTC, Jenkins job #q-4512. :rocket:

maria: once canary passes I'll expand to 3 regions and keep reconcile in pending state until we verify metrics.

ben: also add unit test for burst window logic: ensure reserve + adjust within same request_id does not increase sliding window count.

sam: FYI ops — when canary runs please watch per-key burst metric and pending_reservations tag. Ping #eng-oncall if we see >2x baseline. :eyes:

alex: OK thanks. Moving to triage board. @maria assign PR and follow up with the customer-facing note after reconcile. :thumbsup:

maria: will do — adding changelog note and short FAQ for Console about pending reservations.
